subject: infra.capacity
name: National technical capacity and public-sector technical capability
what_would_settle_it: The base holds zero sources tagged infra.capacity for Cabo Verde; a national compute, HPC or public-sector technical-capability statement from the telecommunications directorate or NOSi would open the subject

subject: infra.capacity
name: The regulator's own budget, staffing and activity
what_would_settle_it: An ARME budget or activity report for any year; the 2026-08-04 acquisition pass recorded the regulator's website timing out on TCP 443 and holds none

subject: infra.connect
name: 5G spectrum assignment or licence award
what_would_settle_it: An ARME spectrum-assignment decision or a national radio frequency plan; the strategy is approved but no band, auction, price or licensee is on file

subject: infra.connect
name: National fibre network length
what_would_settle_it: An ARME or incumbent network statement; the only figure in the base is a Secretary of State's trade-press interview

subject: infra.connect
name: Universal service fund expenditure, projects and beneficiaries
what_would_settle_it: A fund account or activity report, or a Conta Geral do Estado that breaks out the earmarked-revenue counterpart; only the unchanged appropriation figure is held

subject: infra.store
name: Installed data-centre capacity
what_would_settle_it: A technical specification from NOSi or TechPark CV giving rack count, floor area or delivered electrical load in MW for the Praia and Mindelo facilities

subject: infra.store
name: Government cloud, hosting or data-localisation rule
what_would_settle_it: The interoperability-standards diploma and the public-administration data-governance diploma named as 2024 deliverables; the base holds no evidence either was adopted

subject: infra.energy
name: Electricity supply and cost to Cabo Verde's data centres
what_would_settle_it: NOSi's accounts for 2025, which would carry the photovoltaic project's implementation and the data centre's energy cost structure

subject: infra.energy
name: Any national policy linking digital infrastructure to energy
what_would_settle_it: A named instrument; the section's only energy-tagged source carries an undated ministerial statement that electricity capacity will be stabilised, with no figures and no programme

subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Cybersecurity Strategy
what_would_settle_it: The strategy document itself; the base holds only a secondary report that the Secretary of State cited an update of it in a May 2025 interview

subject: infra.cybersec
name: CSIRT incident statistics
what_would_settle_it: A CSIRT or SOC annual report giving incidents handled, sectors affected and response times since the 2025-10-30 launch

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Cybercrime caseload and prosecutions
what_would_settle_it: A judicial police annual report; the base holds three dated warnings from the cybercrime brigade and no case, charge or conviction count

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Final forensic audit of the 2026-05-17 election-night incident
what_would_settle_it: The completed external audit report NOSi commissioned; only preliminary findings dated 2026-05-26 are held

subject: data.satellite
name: State use of Earth observation or satellite data
what_would_settle_it: A Cabo Verdean instrument or agreement naming an EO data source or programme; the base holds zero sources on this subject for Cabo Verde at any date

subject: digital.rural
name: Rural and inter-island last-mile digital service delivery
what_would_settle_it: A programme document or budget sub-line naming rural or outer-island service points, or a deployment schedule with locations; the base holds zero sources on this subject for Cabo Verde

subject: digital.localgov
name: Municipal digital government
what_would_settle_it: A municipal digital services plan or budget from Praia, Mindelo or the national municipalities association, or the municipal component of the state-modernisation programme broken out

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Count or percentage of public services actually online
what_would_settle_it: The Digital Cabo Verde results framework or an implementation status report with the services-online indicator reported against the 60%-by-2026 target, or a portal service inventory

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Award date and jury report for the e-procurement platform contract
what_would_settle_it: The jury report or adjudication notice for the electronic public procurement tender, or the contract's publication in the Boletim Oficial

subject: dpi.id
name: Identity-card enrolment count and mobile-credential activation count
what_would_settle_it: A justice-modernisation institute or civil-identification activity report, or a registry issuance series; the reference pages carry no volume figure of any kind

subject: dpi.pay
name: Government-to-person payment digitisation
what_would_settle_it: A social-protection or treasury instrument stating how benefits and salaries are disbursed, and what share is electronic

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection commission activity report and any enforcement measure
what_would_settle_it: A genuine annual activity report for any year after 2016; no complaint count, inspection count, breach notification count, sanction or fine can be stated for Cabo Verde from any date

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybercrime statute and national cybersecurity framework instrument
what_would_settle_it: The Boletim Oficial texts; the base carries an operational SOC and CSIRT and repeated police cybercrime warnings, but no statute and no prosecution or conviction figure

subject: gov.legislate
name: Artificial-intelligence statute
what_would_settle_it: A bill or diploma in the Boletim Oficial; a named analyst argued for one in April 2025 and the data-protection commission president argued that AI cannot be regulated by operators alone, and the base holds no bill

subject: gov.standards
name: National interoperability framework or standards catalogue
what_would_settle_it: The adopted diploma on interoperability standards announced for 2024, or a published technical standards catalogue; interoperability is asserted as a pillar in every strategy statement from March 2025 onwards and no adopted standard is held

subject: gov.standards
name: Membership status in the African Telecommunications Union
what_would_settle_it: The union's membership register or the readout of the 2026 ITU Council bilateral; the April 2026 account states that membership-related matters were addressed without saying whether Cabo Verde is a member, an applicant or in arrears

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Any binding rule on the use of artificial intelligence
what_would_settle_it: A data-protection commission deliberation or guidance note on automated decision-making, or a draft AI base-law in the Assembly's legislative record

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: ICT sector share of GDP and ICT sector employment
what_would_settle_it: A statistics institute national-accounts or business-survey release breaking out the information and communication sector; the 7%-to-25% figures in circulation are ministerial targets, not measurements

subject: tech.industry
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Technology park disbursement statements and Phase I appraisal
what_would_settle_it: African Development Bank disbursement statements for the two technology-park operations and the Phase I appraisal report; both are on the wiki's acquisition list

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Any Gulf technology or data-centre engagement with Cabo Verde
what_would_settle_it: Nothing is held. A UAE, Saudi or Qatari investment agreement, or an entry in a Gulf sovereign fund's portfolio naming Cabo Verde, would settle it

subject: capacity.literacy
name: National digital literacy programme and skills rate
what_would_settle_it: An adopted national digital skills and readiness strategy, or the statistics institute's household survey module on ICT use; the digital-readiness study of over a thousand respondents commissioned under Digital Cabo Verde has not been published

subject: capacity.research
name: National research funding line for digital or artificial-intelligence research
what_would_settle_it: A budget-table entry naming research or the national university's technology and engineering research centre, in any of the FY2024-FY2026 budget documents held

subject: include.access
name: Free public internet points
what_would_settle_it: A digital economy ministry or universal service fund list of installed sites with dates, or a budget line naming the programme

subject: include.divides
name: Island-level and urban-rural access disaggregation
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's quarterly indicators broken down by island or municipality, or the census or household survey ICT module at sub-national grain

subject: finance.budget
name: Data-protection commission appropriation for FY2026
what_would_settle_it: The National Assembly resolution approving the private budget for 2026; no such resolution is indexed in the Boletim Oficial, breaking a series that ran CVE 35,255,451 for FY2024 and CVE 36,313,115 for FY2025

subject: gov.protect
name: Accession to Council of Europe Convention 108
what_would_settle_it: The Council of Europe treaty office status page, or a national accession resolution in the Boletim Oficial; the base establishes accession to the AU Malabo Convention and nothing on Convention 108
